lines: One chunk holds at least 90.0 % of a page, so the browser fetches practically the whole page before it shows anything:
teams-settings-admin.mjs: 2 files, 1,321,175 B, of which logger-QtKC2m9g.chunk.mjs is 1,278,537 B (96.8 %).

Code splitting puts what the first paint does not need behind a dynamic import, and then the browser fetches it when the code asks. Which part of a page that is does not follow from the build output; the source decides it.
Built with: vite.config.ts, package.json declares @nextcloud/vite-config ^2.5.4, vite ^7.1.12.
Other delivered libraries: 30, axios 1.18.1, date-fns 4.4.0, vite-plugin-node-polyfills 0.24.0, dompurify 3.4.11, focus-trap 8.2.2, @floating-ui/dom 1.1.1, 1.7.6, and 24 more.
Every delivered file in js carries a source map, so every byte can be charged to the package and the module it came from.
4 packages are imported by their root in src, each delivered in fewer than 8 modules, so a per-module import has nothing to leave out and the specifier decides no bytes here.
